messages.subject: Error in recordtable
parts:
I tried to follow the steps of the user guide, but when I use "recordtable" function, it shows an error message:
"Error in if (all(intable$DateTimeOriginal == "-")) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In system(command.tmp, intern = TRUE) :
  running command 'exiftool -q -f -t -r -Directory -FileName -EXIF:DateTimeOriginal -HierarchicalSubject -ext JPG ""' had status 1> "

My camera is Reconyx HyperFire HC500, and I have used the function"fixDateTimeOriginal" to fix the time format.

Can anyone help me to solve the problem? Thanks > <

Stanly

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in recordtable
parts:
Hi Stanly,
this seems to be some unexpected problem with unreadable date/time tags in the images. Can you please share the output of 

exifTagNames (..., returnMetadata = TRUE)

Run it on the directory that you run recordTable on (after using fixDateTimeOriginal).
Preferably please also share the output of exifTagNames before running fixDateTimeOriginal.

Thank you,
Jürgen
